name: W20 Microsoft token exchange (sub-workflow, no execution data saved)

conditions.leftValue: ={{ $('Called by W20 MS callback').first().json.has_code && !!$('Called by W20 MS callback').first().json.broker_id }}

parameters.query:
-- The ONLY place the refresh token goes (migration 13, n8n_app only). Never in a column, a log or a response.
select public.smc_vault_store_ms_refresh($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4) as token_ref;

parameters.content:
## W20 Microsoft token exchange (I-43e)
Only W20's callback calls this (by id `smc-w20-ms-token`). It exchanges the authorisation code, plans, stores the refresh token in the vault RPC and returns the PUBLIC plan + `token_ref` only. `saveDataErrorExecution` and `saveDataSuccessExecution` are both `none`, so a crash mid-run cannot persist the token in execution data (the parent never holds it). Input `{ state, query, broker_id, current_status }`. Same credentials as before (no new names).
